events.name: game.new
events.doc: The player starts a new game, when the first map is set up.

events.name: save.begin
events.doc: The game starts writing a save.

events.name: save.done
events.doc: A save has been written (or failed: ok says which).

events.name: save.load
events.doc: A save has been read and the game is about to run from it.

fields.name: play_seconds
fields.doc: play time of the loaded save

fields.name: state_in_step
fields.doc: reads 0: whether the mod's own saved data was written with this save is a per-mod answer, and the payload is built once for every handler of the event, so the mod asks the services table's `state_in_step` (`docs/mod-state.md`, section 2)

events.name: game.cleared
events.doc: The player beat the Champion; the ending (Hall of Fame, credits, the save screen) starts.
events.where: `EVENT_GAMECLEAR_Create` 0x0215F8A8, the ending: Hall of Fame (ov180), credits (ov181), save screen (ov205)

fields.name: play_seconds
fields.doc: play time at the Hall of Fame

events.name: route.change
events.doc: The player is in a new zone, by any way in: a map change (a door, stairs, a warp tile, Fly, Dig, an Escape Rope, a whiteout, a script) or a walk over a zone border on the same map.
events.where: `FIELD_MAP_CHANGE_SetupZone` 0x021643E8 (ov010, every map change: `how` warp); the return of `FIELDMAP_ChangeZone` 0x021893C0 (ov021, a walk over a zone border: `how` walk)

fields.name: how
fields.doc: `EIDOS_ZONE_WARP` (a map change: a door, stairs, a warp tile, Fly, Dig, an Escape Rope, a whiteout, a script) or `EIDOS_ZONE_WALK` (a walk over a zone border on the same map)

events.name: map.warp
events.doc: The player is about to warp to another map (a door, stairs, Fly, a cave exit); the destination can be changed.

events.name: player.step
events.doc: The player finished a step on the field.

events.name: trainer.spotted
events.doc: A trainer saw the player and is about to walk up for a battle; refused, the trainer does not see the player.
events.refuse: the trainer does not see the player (the function returns no event)

fields.name: trainer_id
fields.doc: the trainer who saw the player

fields.name: partner_id
fields.doc: the second trainer of a double, or 0

events.name: npc.talk
events.doc: The player pressed A at a person or object; refused, nothing happens.
events.refuse: no person is found ahead; the A press goes on to the sign and tile checks

fields.name: object_id
fields.doc: the person or object talked to

events.name: menu.open
events.doc: The player opened the field menu (X); refused, it does not open.
events.refuse: the menu does not open (no event is returned)

events.name: menu.build
events.doc: The field menu lists its entries; the list can be changed.
events.modify: entries (a cleared entry is hidden; one added is not built)

fields.name: entries
fields.doc: one bit per menu entry shown

events.name: field.move
events.doc: The game checks whether one of its ten field action slots is allowed here (FIELD_SKILL_CHECK_FillUseFlags asks for each, slot 0 to 9).
events.details: The bag and the Y shortcut menu read these slots: slot 0 is the bicycle; the other slots are zone and tile checks whose items are not mapped yet. Refused, the slot answers "not allowed".  `move` is the slot number, not a move id.  The party screen's field moves (Cut, Surf, Fly, Dig, Teleport...) do not go through this check and do not fire it yet.
events.refuse: the field action slot answers "not allowed"

fields.name: move
fields.doc: the field action slot, 0 to 9 (0 the bicycle); not a move id

events.name: pc.open
events.doc: A script opens the Pokemon storage system: a PC (in a Pokemon Centre or anywhere else) or the Battle Box.
events.details: It is the only way into the box screen.  Refused, it does not open.
events.where: `SCRCMD_PROC_FLD_CallOv170Event` 0x021B4D60, the script command that opens the box screen (the PC, and the battle box with its kind 4)
events.refuse: the PC does not open; the script reads a plain exit

events.name: encounter.wild
events.doc: A wild Pokemon was rolled on the field, before the battle starts; species, level and shiny can be changed, or the roll done again; refused, there is no encounter.
events.where: the return of `FIELD_ENCOUNT_CreateZoneWildMons` 0x021A954C; roamers the return of `FIELD_ENCOUNT_PickRoamer` 0x021A957C
events.refuse: no battle; the player keeps walking; the payload names the area, the method (grass, surf, fishing, shaking grass) and the slot
events.modify: species, level, shiny; the second Pokemon of a double; a reroll

fields.name: method
fields.doc: grass, dark grass, surf, fishing, shaking grass, rippling water, dust

fields.name: reroll
fields.doc: 1 rolls the encounter again with the game's own roll and fires the event again, at most 16 times; the last answer stands

fields.name: level2
fields.doc: the second Pokemon of a double (dark grass), 0 when there is none

events.name: encounter.static
events.doc: A story or fixed battle with a wild Pokemon is about to start (a legendary, a gift battle); species and level can be changed.

events.name: encounter.trainer
events.doc: A trainer battle is about to be set up.

events.name: mon.create
events.doc: The game creates a Pokemon (wild, gift, egg, a trainer's); species, level, shiny and nature can be changed.

fields.name: nature
fields.doc: the nature, or 0xFF to leave the roll

fields.name: personality
fields.doc: the personality value the game rolled

events.name: mon.receive
events.doc: The player gets a Pokemon (a catch, a gift, a static encounter, an egg, a trade), when it is stored.
events.where: catch `EVENT_BATTLE_RETURN_Main` 0x021B9614 (ov092, the store step); gifts `SCRCMD_PROC_AddMonToParty` 0x0215C510, `SCRCMD_PROC_AddMonToBox` 0x0215C4C8, `SCRCMD_PROC_AddEggToParty` 0x0215C2D0 (ov010); `SCRCMD_POKEMON_FLD_ReceiveGiftMon` 0x021B6F18, daycare egg `SODATEYA_ReceiveEgg` 0x021C32F4 (ov021); in-game trade `FLD_TRADE_CreateEvent` 0x021CC500 (ov021)

fields.name: source
fields.doc: catch, gift, static, egg, in-game trade

fields.name: to_box
fields.doc: it goes to a box because the party is full

events.name: mon.nickname
events.doc: The nickname screen opens for a Pokemon (after a catch or from a person).
events.modify: force the prompt (marked, but the row carries no applier, so a write to it has no effect)

fields.name: mon
fields.doc: the Pokemon; empty on the prompt's own row, the caught Pokemon on the catch screen's

fields.name: force
fields.doc: 1 opens the prompt even when the game would skip it (reads 0; the row has no applier)

events.name: mon.evolve
events.doc: The game found that a Pokemon evolves (level, item, trade, friendship), before the evolution scene; refused, it does not evolve.
events.refuse: no evolution starts; an evolution stone has no effect

events.name: mon.exp
events.doc: A party Pokemon is about to gain experience (once per member in a battle, or at the day care); the amount can be changed.

fields.name: wild
fields.doc: for a battle, 1 when the battle is a wild one

events.name: mon.levelup
events.doc: A Pokemon reached a new level.
events.where: the return of `BTL_POKEPARAM_AddExp` 0x021D69B8, inside `BTL_SERVER_FLOW_ApplyPartyExp` 0x021C5350 (the level crossing)

fields.name: source
fields.doc: `EIDOS_LEVELUP_BATTLE`, or `EIDOS_LEVELUP_ITEM` (a Rare Candy on the party screen)

events.name: move.learn
events.doc: A Pokemon is about to learn a move (level-up, the day care, a tutor); refused, it does not learn it.
events.where: level-up `POKE_TOOL_GetLevelUpMove` 0x02018328 (arm9); daycare `SODATEYA_LearnMove` 0x021C360C (ov021); the party screen's `POKELIST_TryLearnMove` 0x021BA5B4 and `POKELIST_ReplaceMoveSlot` 0x021BA5E0 (ov091); the nurse's relearner `POKE_SUMMARY_MAIN_ApplyMove` 0x021B6B0C (ov173); the script command that writes a move `SCRCMD_PROC_SetMonMove` 0x0215BD2C (ov010)
events.refuse: the level-up, the day care and the script: the move is not learned. The party screen's rows and the relearner's cannot be refused; the payload names the move and the source

fields.name: source
fields.doc: level, TM, tutor, relearner; 0 also stands for the rows that name no teacher

fields.name: slot
fields.doc: the move slot it goes into, or 0xFF when the row names none

events.name: mon.release
events.doc: The player releases a Pokemon in the storage system; refused, it stays.

events.refuse: the Pokemon stays; the box redraws it

events.name: box.deposit
events.doc: The player moves a party Pokemon into a box; refused, it stays in the party.
events.where: `BOX2_MAIN_UpdateBoxSlots` 0x021DD530, a party Pokemon placed in a box
events.refuse: the move is not applied; the box screen's own next step redraws the icons

fields.name: mon
fields.doc: the Pokemon, where it is now

fields.name: box
fields.doc: the box it moves into or out of

events.name: box.withdraw
events.doc: The player moves a box Pokemon into the party; refused, it stays in the box.
events.where: `BOX2_MAIN_UpdateBoxSlots` 0x021DD530, a box Pokemon placed in the party
events.refuse: as `box.deposit`

fields.name: mon
fields.doc: the Pokemon, where it is now

fields.name: box
fields.doc: the box it moves into or out of

events.name: party.swap
events.doc: Two party positions are swapped (the party screen, the storage system); refused, the order stays.
events.refuse: the order does not change; the party screen redraws from the party

events.name: mon.helditem
events.doc: A party Pokemon's held item changes on the party screen.

events.name: egg.hatch
events.doc: An egg hatches.

events.name: trade.ingame

events.refuse: the trade does not happen and the script goes on

events.name: mon.cure
events.doc: A Pokemon's status is about to be cured, by an item, a move, an ability, a berry or a party heal.
events.details: status is the game's own number: 1 paralysis, 2 sleep, 3 freeze, 4 burn, 5 poison; in a battle, 6 and up are the battle's own conditions (confusion and the others).  A refusal keeps the status (on the party screen the item is not used; in a battle the game's text may still say it was cured).
events.where: `PLIST_DEMO_CheckItemUsable` 0x021BDD78 (ov091); `BTL_SERVER_FLOW_CureSick` 0x021C5620 (ov093); after the party heals of `heal`, for each member they cured
events.refuse: the status stays; an item on the party screen is kept

fields.name: status
fields.doc: 1 paralysis, 2 sleep, 3 freeze, 4 burn, 5 poison; in a battle 6 and up are the battle's own conditions

events.name: mon.pp
events.doc: A move is about to get PP back, from an Ether or an Elixir or in a battle.
events.details: amount is the PP it gets, before the cap at its max.  A refusal gives none.
events.refuse: no PP

fields.name: move
fields.doc: the move (0 in a battle for now)

fields.name: amount
fields.doc: the PP it gets, before the cap at its max

events.name: mon.form
events.doc: A Pokemon is about to change form, outside a battle or in one.
events.details: A refusal keeps the form it has; `to` can be changed.
events.refuse: the form stays

fields.name: source
fields.doc: `EIDOS_FORM_FIELD` (an item, the season, a script) or `EIDOS_FORM_BATTLE` (an ability, a move, a held item)

events.name: battle.start
events.doc: A battle is set up and about to start; the format and a level change for the opposing Pokemon can be set.
events.where: `BTL_SETUP_Create` 0x02013090 (arm9); the return of the setups: the wild `BTL_SETUP_SetupWild` 0x0201347C (arm9), the trainer `FIELD_ENCOUNT_SetupTrainerBattle` 0x021AA5CC (ov021), the scripted `EVENT_BATTLE_CreateScriptedBattle` 0x0216E7C8 (ov010)
events.modify: format, levels; the payload names the trainer ids and whether the battle is wild

fields.name: wild
fields.doc: a wild battle; 0 at the row that creates the setup

fields.name: format
fields.doc: single, double, triple, rotation, multi; 0xFF where the port does not know the format yet (the row that creates the setup)

fields.name: level_adjust
fields.doc: added to every opposing Pokemon's level

fields.name: opponent_party

events.doc: A Pokemon of either side picks its action for the turn (fight, item, switch, run); refused, the choice is not allowed.
events.where: fight `BTL_CLIENT_IsMoveSelectionBlocked` 0x021CF5B0; run `BTL_CLIENT_GetEscapeBlockerForSide` 0x021CF918 (inside `BTL_CLIENT_StepSelectRun`); switch the return of `BTL_PICK_GetLast` 0x0689CB1C (ov095, inside `BTL_CLIENT_StepSelectSwitchTarget`)
events.refuse: the choice is not accepted and the action menu stays; the payload names the action and, for fight, the move

fields.name: side
fields.doc: 0 the player's, 1 the opponent's (the AI asks the move check too)

events.name: battle.item
events.doc: The player picked an item from the battle bag; refused, the item is not used.
events.refuse: back to the action menu; the item stays in the bag and the turn is not spent

fields.name: mon

fields.name: revive

events.doc: A Pokemon tries to run from a wild battle; refused, it cannot escape.
events.refuse: the escape fails as a failed run: "Can't escape!" and the turn is spent

events.name: battle.move
events.doc: A Pokemon used a move.

events.name: battle.damage
events.doc: A move's damage on one target was worked out, before it is dealt; the damage can be changed.
events.modify: the amount; the payload names attacker, target, move and the target's HP before

fields.name: target_hp
fields.doc: the target's HP before the hit

fields.name: effectiveness
fields.doc: no effect, not very, neutral, super effective

events.name: battle.faint
events.doc: A Pokemon fainted in a battle.
events.where: the return of `BTL_SERVER_FLOW_ProcFaintedPoke` 0x021C4F64, when it answers 1 (a Pokemon has just fainted; the server asks about every Pokemon a move touched)

fields.name: cause_damage
fields.doc: the last damage, or 0 for weather, a hazard or a status

events.name: catch.attempt
events.doc: The player throws a ball; the catch rate can be changed; refused, the throw does nothing.
events.refuse: the ball is blocked as in a trainer battle: the block message shows, the ball stays in the bag, the turn is spent; the payload names the ball and the target's species and level

fields.name: rate
fields.doc: the catch rate the roll uses, as a percentage of the game's own factor

fields.name: static_
fields.doc: 1 when `encounter.static` started the battle (a story or fixed Pokemon), 0 for a wild roll

events.name: catch.result
events.doc: A thrown ball shook and the catch succeeded or failed.

events.name: battle.end
events.doc: A battle ended (won, lost, ran, caught).

events.name: whiteout
events.doc: The player lost a battle with no Pokemon left (the battle half) and is taken back to heal (the field half).
events.where: `SCRCMD_NETWORK_CreateWhiteOutEvent` 0x0215F6E8 (ov010): every whiteout after a lost wild or trainer battle (`in_battle` 1); the mod API's own `whiteout()` raises none

fields.name: in_battle
fields.doc: 1 the battle half, 0 the field half

events.name: battle.trainer_mon
events.doc: A trainer battle is about to start: once for each Pokemon of the opposing trainer's party.
events.details: It fires once per member, in party order.  A refusal takes the member out of the party (the last one always stays).  A changed field is written to the Pokemon with the game's own setters: a new species or level works out the stats again, a new move gets its full PP.  0 in a *mod field leaves the game's value.
events.where: the rows that build a trainer battle's setup (`battle.start`), once per opposing member
events.refuse: the member leaves the party (the last stays)
events.modify: species, level, item, moves, ability, form

fields.name: index
fields.doc: the position in the party, 0 first

events.name: battle.exp
events.doc: The battle is about to hand out experience to the party after an opposing Pokemon fainted.
events.details: It fires before mon.exp fires for each member that gains.  A refusal gives nobody any experience (and mon.exp does not fire); scale changes every member's share. Version 5 appends share: when a handler sets it, every party member that would gain nothing (it did not fight and holds no Exp. Share) and can battle gets that percentage of what it would have gained had it fought, with its own level, Lucky Egg, trade bonus and effort values, as the later games' Exp. Share does.  scale applies after it.
events.refuse: nobody gains
events.modify: the scale of every share, the bench's share

fields.name: members
fields.doc: bit i: party position i gains

fields.name: scale
fields.doc: a percentage of every share; 100 leaves them

events.name: battle.ai
events.doc: A Pokemon the game controls (a trainer's, or a wild one for the move stage) has made one of its choices for the turn.
events.details: It fires at each stage the game goes through, after the game's own choice, and a handler may replace that choice: - item: `item` is the item the trainer uses (0 none).  Writing another item uses that one; writing 0 uses none (the trainer's item the game picked is spent either way). - switch: `switch_to` is the party position switched to, 6 for none (only with a trainer).  A position of a Pokemon that cannot battle or is already out is ignored. - move: `move` is the move slot (0 to 3; 4 to run, for a wild one), `target_pos` the battle position aimed at; `scores` are the game's own points for each slot after its AI scripts (moves with no PP score 0). The stages follow each other: a Pokemon that uses an item or switches does not reach the move stage.

fields.name: target
fields.doc: move stage: the Pokemon the game's scripts aimed at

fields.name: switch_to
fields.doc: switch stage: the party position switched to, 6 none; a position that cannot battle or is out is ignored

fields.name: move
fields.doc: move stage: the move slot, 0 to 3 (4 runs, for a wild Pokemon)

fields.name: target_pos
fields.doc: move stage: the battle position aimed at

fields.name: item
fields.doc: item stage: the trainer's item used, 0 none; another item is used instead, 0 uses none (the item the game picked is spent either way)

fields.name: scores
fields.doc: move stage: the game's own points per move slot after its AI scripts

events.name: battle.ai_replace
events.doc: A trainer sends in Pokemon after a faint.
events.details: `order` lists the party positions that can battle, the game's own preference first (the one that hits the foe hardest); the first ones are sent.  A handler may reorder the list; positions not in it are ignored.

fields.name: foe
fields.doc: the Pokemon the game measured against

fields.name: order
fields.doc: the party positions, in the order they go in

events.name: battle.ability
events.doc: An ability shows itself (the game's ability banner): Intimidate on entry, Contrary turning a drop, and so on.

events.name: battle.stat

events.details: `stat` is the game's stat id (1 attack, 2 defense, 3 special attack, 4 special defense, 5 speed, 6 accuracy, 7 evasion), `delta` the stages it moves by.

events.name: battle.held_item

events.details: `item` is the item, also when it was used up by its effect.

events.name: battle.status

events.details: `status` is the game's condition id (the major statuses 1 paralysis, 2 sleep, 3 freeze, 4 burn, 5 poison, then confusion and the others of the battle's own list), `applied` whether it took.

fields.name: source

events.doc: An item is about to go into the bag; the count can be changed.

fields.name: source
fields.doc: `EIDOS_ITEM_FROM_SCRIPT` (an item on the ground, a gift from a person), `_GIFT`, `_PURCHASE`, `_BATTLE`, `_RETURN` (a held item or mail back to the bag), `_REWARD`, `_OTHER`

events.doc: The player picked an item in a shop, before choosing how many; the price of one can be changed; refused, the shop goes back to its list.
events.refuse: back to the item list; no money changes hands

fields.name: price

events.doc: The player's money is about to go up or down; the change can be changed.

events.where: `SCRCMD_PROC_HealParty` 0x0215B5A8 (ov010, a centre or a script); `GPOWER_UseHpRestore` 0x0201104C (arm9, the HP-restore power)
events.refuse: the heal does not happen; the script's own text still plays

fields.name: source
fields.doc: Pokemon Centre or script, the HP-restore power

events.name: heal.hp
events.doc: A Pokemon that has HP is about to get more, from an item, a move, an ability, a held item or a party heal.
events.details: The amount is the HP the game is about to add, before the cap at max_hp; a handler changes it, or refuses the event and the Pokemon gets nothing.  A fainted Pokemon coming back is mon.revive, not this event.  On the field the item is still used up: a mod that wants the item kept refuses item.use instead.
events.where: `PLIST_DEMO_RestoreHp` 0x021BE914 (ov091, an item on the field); `BTL_SERVER_FLOW_ApplyHpRecover` 0x021C33E8 (ov093, every restore in a battle); after the party heals of `heal`, for each member they gave HP to
events.refuse: no HP is added

fields.name: mon
fields.doc: the Pokemon that gets HP back

fields.name: amount
fields.doc: the HP to add, before the cap at max HP

fields.name: source
fields.doc: field (an item from the bag or the party screen) or battle (any restore: bag item, held item, move, ability)

events.name: mon.revive
events.doc: A fainted Pokemon is about to come back, from a revive item, Sacred Ash or a party heal.
events.details: A refusal keeps it fainted; for an item, the item is not used up.  The hp is what it comes back with, at least 1, at most max_hp.
events.where: `PLIST_DEMO_CheckItemUsable` 0x021BDD78 and `PLIST_DEMO_RestoreHp` 0x021BE914 (ov091); `BTL_SERVER_FLOW_ItemEffectRevive` 0x021CC008 (ov093); after the party heals of `heal`, for each member they revived
events.refuse: the Pokemon stays fainted; an item is kept where the game allows (`docs/mod-payloads.md`)

fields.name: hp
fields.doc: the HP it comes back with; at least 1, at most `max_hp`
